resources.string: Select your own disc image: a complete .bin with 2352-byte sectors (the file next to the .cue). Arcade, Simulation and the combined disc are supported. The image is copied into the app; game data is never included or downloaded.\n\nPlay with a Bluetooth or USB controller. Start + Select (or holding Start) opens the settings.
Installed: %1$s. Tap Play, or import another disc.
That is the .cue sheet. Select the .bin file it points to.
This is not a raw 2352-byte BIN. ISO files lose the XA music and movies; dump or convert the disc to BIN/CUE.
Compressed images (CHD, PBP, ECM, ZIP, 7z) are not supported. Extract or convert it to BIN/CUE first.
Not enough free storage. About %1$d MB are needed.
